name: BioMysteryBench
intro: BioMysteryBench 是 Anthropic 构建的 99 题生物信息学科研基准。领域专家从真实的原始或最小处理组学数据中设计具有客观实验或临床真值的谜题，并用验证 Notebook 证明信号存在；模型可自由选择分析路线，只按最终生物学结论评分。
build_method: 领域专家客观真值命题, 验证Notebook, 最多五位专家人类基线, 困难题复核
modality: 组学数据, 文本, 代码
task_type: 生物信息学Agent, 开放式科研问题, 端到端数据分析
eval_feature: 与方法无关的客观结论评分, 可安装工具并访问批准数据库, 人类可解与困难子集
scale: 99题（76道人类可解, 23道人类困难）; 完整数据约159 GB
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Anthropic's official BioMysteryBench methodology and dataset card. The diagram preserves expert construction from raw or minimally processed sequencing, proteomics, and metabolomics data; objective controlled properties or orthogonally validated metadata; a required validation notebook; public problem packages with questions, anonymized data, answer rubrics, and allowed domains; up to five expert attempts per task; removal of four malformed human-unsolved items; the final 99-task split into 76 human-solvable and 23 human-difficult problems; the canonical-tools container with pip, conda, NCBI, and Ensembl access; method-agnostic final-answer grading; five episodes per problem; and separate accuracy and solve-consistency reporting.
task_type_en: Bioinformatics agent, open-ended research problem, end-to-end data analysis
build_method_en: Domain-expert objective-ground-truth questions, validation notebooks, up-to-five-expert human baselines, difficult-item re-review
eval_feature_en: Method-agnostic objective-conclusion grading, installable tools and approved databases, human-solvable and difficult subsets
intro_en: BioMysteryBench is a 99-problem bioinformatics research benchmark built by Anthropic. Domain experts derive mysteries with objective experimental or clinical ground truth from real raw or minimally processed omics data and provide validation notebooks showing that the signal exists; models may choose any analytical route and are graded only on the final biological conclusion.
